{{Quote|The girl was a young Nosaurian aide in Professor Eppington's department. I'd passed her hundreds of times in the hall, but of course Sanbra is a big place.|Tem Eliss|<ref name="The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Nosaurians">{{GamerCite|9|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Nosaurians}}</ref>}}
'''Eppington''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who was part of a department at the [[University of Sanbra]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. At least one [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] was a member of the professor's department. [[Sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] was Eppington's colleague.<ref name="The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Nosaurians" />
